# Arctrix
> Architecting Tomorrow.

Arctrix is a futuristic, AI-driven technology brand building real problem-solving products. We merge deep psychology, elegant aesthetics, and cutting-edge engineering to forge tools that genuinely solve problems.

## Products

### QuantC
Zero-knowledge, AES-256 encrypted file sharing platform. True anonymity. Transfer up to 1GB+ seamlessly without logs or accounts.
- URL: https://quantc-arya.vercel.app/

### xWavy
AI-powered audio enhancement app for Android. Effortlessly isolate vocals and eradicate background noise for studio-grade sound.
- URL: https://xwavy.vercel.app/
